description: Read BetSlip Doctor’s league order right now: leagues with games in play first, then the soonest tip within 6 hours, then by games in the next 24 hours, then this week’s popularity times season phase (rank, weight, phase, inSeason, featured). `slate` carries the default league and the featured game (the in-play or soonest game with the most markets), refreshed every 5 minutes. Live, Home, Pick’Em and the Doctor’s slate use this same order. Read-only; no account data.
name: get_league_order
title: Read the league order
